title: SuffixArrayBuilder is reached from SuffixArray::build
body:
`SuffixArrayBuilder` (`libsufr/src/build.rs`) is reached through its own constructors, `from_sequence_file(path, delimiter)` and `from_data(text, sequences)`. Options are set with `with_alphabet`, `with_seed_mask`, `with_num_partitions`, `with_memory_budget` and `with_write_lcp`. `build_to_file(path) -> Result<()>` writes the file and returns nothing else, so a caller opens the result with `SuffixArray::open`. `SuffixArray` (`lib.rs`) has `open` and `open_with` but no way to start a build, so a user learns two entry points for one type.

## Proposal

`SuffixArray::build(..)` returns the builder, so a build reads as `SuffixArray::build(..).with_alphabet(..).build_to_file(..)`. Whether `SuffixArrayBuilder` keeps any public constructor of its own is open; the builder may be a type a user only ever receives.

## Open

- What `build` takes: the path, the text and sequences, or one call per source.
- Whether `from_sequence_file` and `from_data` stay public, become `pub(crate)`, or go.

This waits on the builder redesign that separates configuration from construction, since that decides what the builder's surface is.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/5bf3e231
notes.text: The builder's shape was fixed during the reorganization and has landed by 6df218d: SuffixArrayBuilder keeps its constructors, the with_ setters and build_to_file, and nothing else; the names chosen on dev at e8655c9 (SuffixArrayBuilder, from_sequence_file, from_data, with_*, build_to_file) stay; the construction stages are free functions under libsufr/src/build/, each taking the text as &[u8] plus the values it reads, with mask: Option<&SeedMask> and max_query_len: usize as two parameters. This was a section of CLAUDE.md until the file was cut back to rules.
